metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Brooklyn, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI for NO2 data - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' - Date ranges: Oct 1-23 for 2018, 2019, and 2021 - Location: Brooklyn, New York (need to define a polygon) 2. Masking strategy: - TROPOMI NO2 data has quality flags, but the main band is already processed - Will use the 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' band directly - Need to check for valid pixels 3. Logic: - Compare 2021 mean NO2 with 2019 and 2018 means - If 2021 is lower than both 2018 AND 2019 → A (Yes) - Else → B (No) - Handle empty collections, no valid pixels, calculation failures I'll define a polygon for Brooklyn and get mean NO2 concentrations for each period. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const brooklyn = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-74.042, 40.570], [-73.855, 40.570], [-73.855, 40.739], [-74.042, 40.739], [-74.042, 40.570] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check function getNO2Data(year) { const startDate = year + '-10-01'; const endDate = year + '-10-23'; const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(brooklyn) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); return collection; } const collections = { '2018': getNO2Data('2018'), '2019': getNO2Data('2019'), '2021': getNO2Data('2021') }; // Check for empty collections for (const [year, col] of Object.entries(collections)) { const size = col.size().getInfo(); print(year + ' Images: ' + size); if (size === 0) { print('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NO2 for each period const results = {}; for (const [year, col] of Object.entries(collections)) { const meanImage = col.mean(); // Get pixel count and mean value const stats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: brooklyn, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanVal = stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const count = stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); print(year + ' Mean NO2: ' + (meanVal ? meanVal.toFixed(6) : 'null') + ', Pixels: ' + count); // Check for no valid pixels if (count === 0) { print('C2'); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (meanVal === null || meanVal === undefined || !isFinite(meanVal)) { print('C3'); return; } results[year] = meanVal; } // 4. Comparison logic const no2_2021 = results['2021']; const no2_2019 = results['2019']; const no2_2018 = results['2018']; print('Comparison: 2021 (' + no2_2021.toFixed(6) + ') vs 2019 (' + no2_2019.toFixed(6) + ') vs 2018 (' + no2_2018.toFixed(6) + ')'); // Check if 2021 is lower than both 2019 AND 2018 if (no2_2021 < no2_2019 && no2_2021 < no2_2018) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
